title: Block Large Writes
summary: A Claude Code hook that rejects Write calls over a size limit, which catches runaway generated files before they land in your repository.
description: A model that loops can paste a huge blob into a single file, such as a minified bundle or a repeated table. This PreToolUse hook measures the content of each Write call and refuses anything over 200 KB.
Set the MAX_WRITE_KB environment variable to move the limit. Smaller writes and Edit calls are untouched.
useWhen: Stop a stuck loop from filling a file with repeated text
Keep pasted data dumps out of the repo
Catch an agent writing a bundle by hand
Add a cheap size cap on every new file

hook.command: node -e "process.on('uncaughtException',()=>process.exit(0));let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const f=String(i.file_path||'');const fs=require('fs');const c=i.content;if(typeof c!=='string')process.exit(0);const kb=Number(process.env.MAX_WRITE_KB)||200;const n=Buffer.byteLength(c)/1024;if(n>kb){console.error('Blocked: this write is '+Math.round(n)+' KB, over the '+kb+' KB limit. Write a smaller file, split it, or generate it with a script instead of pasting its text.');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)})"

example.prompt: Write the full vendor library inline into src/lib.js.
example.result: The write is blocked with its size and the limit. The agent installs the package or splits the content instead.

faq.question: How do I change the limit?
faq.answer: Set MAX_WRITE_KB to a number of kilobytes in the environment that starts Claude Code. Without it the cap is 200.

faq.question: Does it check edits too?
faq.answer: No, only whole-file Write calls carry full content, so that is the only tool it watches.

access: Reads the content sent to the Write tool
Blocks oversized writes; writes nothing itself
